# *** ON IMAGE NUMBERS - READ THIS BEFORE USING THEM ***
# This film (DGS 4530325) presents under two viewer states with different image numbering, and the
# difference is NOT a constant offset - the two sets hold different content.
#   718-image "Film # 004530325" view - the COMPLETE film. It carries TWO rolls. Roll 29 runs to image
#     171, where a title card reads "Indice Bautismos, VOLUMEN: A-D, Anos 1879-1900" followed by
#     "CONTINUA EN EL PROXIMO ROLLO". Images 172-178 are leader, density and title cards for Rollo 30,
#     and the volume resumes at image 179 marked "CONTINUACION".
#   655-image "Indice de bautismos 1879-1900" waypoint - INCOMPLETE. It omits the roll-30 continuation
#     of Volume 1, i.e. the tail of C (1897-1900) and THE WHOLE OF D. It runs C at 1897 straight into
#     the "Volumen 2, Letras E-Ll" title card. 718 minus 655 is 63 images, which is that missing segment
#     plus its cards.
# So: D exists ONLY in the 718-image view. Image numbers below say which view they were taken in.
# They are LOCATORS ONLY, never evidence. Every page was verified on arrival by letter, year, Libro and
# folio range, and those spans - which are stable across both views - are what this file actually records.
